caption: The drawing depicts a single, headless mannequin dressed in a light green historical gown with a wide, full skirt and fitted bodice. The gown features a square neckline adorned with ruffles and trim, three-quarter length sleeves with ruffled cuffs, and a ruffled hem at the bottom of the skirt. There are vertical ruffle-edged decorations running down the skirt from the waist, bordered with thin lines, and adorned with several small matching green bows spaced evenly along the ruffles. The same ruffle and bow detailing is present at the edge of the sleeves and mid-bodice. The dress is primarily rendered in shades of light green with subtle shading for depth. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, uncolored technical sketch showing the back and side view of the same gown, highlighting its construction and design elements. The drawing is on an off-white background with faint yellowish discolorations along the edges.
title: Dress
